fields.Name: T257 - Duplicate Detection Run
fields.Description: Exercises the semantic duplicate-detection run (RunDetection) with its progress/KPI/kanban rendering — a bespoke pipeline distinct from tag/vector operations.

InputDefinition.goal: Switch to the Knowledge Hub app (application switcher dropdown next to the logo) and click 'Duplicates' in the left nav (fa-clone icon). In the top-right header, open the 'Select entity document…' dropdown and pick an entity document, then click the 'Run Detection' button. Success is that detection starts — a progress section with a stage label and percent appears — and afterward the KPI strip (Total Groups / Pending / Approved / Rejected) and a kanban board (or a 'No duplicate detection results' empty state) render. You do NOT need to approve or merge anything. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Duplicates screen loads with an entity-document selector and a Run Detection button (disabled until a document is chosen)
Selecting a document and clicking Run Detection shows a detection progress state and/or the KPI strip + kanban board (a valid empty-results state counts)
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
